- **Duration:** the original duration went from 2 to 20 working days (+18 days).
- **Dates:** the start moved +47 days, to 2029-04-20. The finish moved +65 days, to 2029-05-17.
- **Total float:** it went from 0 to -59 days, so the activity is now well behind its required dates.
- **Successor:** it has one, #P07-A002-STN-0110 (Set out retaining wall, section 2), linked finish-to-finish with a 1-day lag.

About two-thirds of the finish slip could come from the longer duration itself. The rest seems to come from the later start, which this one predecessor controls. I can trace what is driving that date if you want to see where the delay comes from.
